chapter.verse: Tua bangin sawltakte in mite' kiangah thu a gen laitak siampite, biakinn-cing bupa, leh Sadducee-te hong pai uh a,
sawltakte in mite hilhcianin misite' lakpan thawhkikna thu Jesu' hangin pulak uh ahih manin nakpi nopmawh sa uh hi.
Tua hangin amaute in sawltakte man uh a, nitak hita ahih manin a zingciang dong gilbem ah khum uh hi.
Ahih hangin thu a za mi tampitak in um uh a, a malin mi tulnga bang pha uh hi.
A zingciangin a uliante uh, a makaite uh leh a laisiamte uh Jerusalem ah hong kikaikhawm uh hi.
Siampi lianpenpa Annas zong om a, Caiaphas, John, Alexander leh siampi lianpenpa' innkuan sunga kihel teng zong om uh hi.
Amaute' laizang ah Peter leh John a koih khit uh ciangin, “Hih thu, kua' tha kua' min tawh na hih uh ahi hiam?” ci-in dong uh hi.
Tua ciangin Peter pen Kha Siangtho tawh hong kidim a, tua mite' kiangah, “Gam-uk uliante leh Jew makaite aw,
a zawngkhal mi khat tunga kibawl nahoih thu—bangci danin amah kidamsak cih thu—tuni-in kote hong kidongtel ahihleh

singlamteh tunga na khailup uh, misite' lakpan Pasian' thawhkiksak Nazareth khuami Jesu Khris, ama' min tawh hih mipa note' mai-ah cidamin om hi cih thu, no teng khempeuh leh Israel minam bup sungah kithei ta hen.
Tua Jesu pen no innlamte' nilkhiat, tu-in khuambul suangpi a suak khinzo suangtum pen ahi hi.
Tua hi a, vanpi nuai-a om mite lakah eite hotkhiat i ngah pelmawh nadinga kipia min a dang khat zong om lo ahih manin midang kuamah' kiangah hotkhiatna om lo hi,” ci hi.
Amaute in Peter leh John a hanna mu-in laisiamlo minautang ahihlam a theih uh ciangin lamdang sa mahmah uh hi. Jesu tawh kikhawl ngei uh ahihlam zong phawkkik uh hi.
Himah taleh damna a ngah mipa amau' gei-a ding mu uh ahih manin bangmah nial theilo uh hi.
Ahih hangin Sanhedrin pan sawltakte' paikhiat ding thupiak a bawl khit uh ciangin amau teng kikum uh a,
“Hih mite bangci hih ding i hi hiam? A hang pen amaute' tungtawnin kihilna lim a simtaak khat piang khinzo cih Jerusalem khuami khempeuh' theih hi a, ei' nialtheih thu hilo hi.
Himah taleh mite lakah hih thu a kizelhbeh loh nadingin hih min tawh kuama' tungah thu a gen nawnlo dingin amaute lauphawn ni,” kici uh hi.
Tua ciangin sawltakte sam uh a, Jesu' min tawh thugen leh thuhilh a zat nawn peuhmah loh nadingun thupia uh hi.
Ahih hangin Peter leh John in, “Pasian' thu sangin note' thu kong man ding uh Pasian' muhna ah maan maanlo cih nomaumah in khensat un.
A hang pen kote in ka muhsa uh leh ka zaksa uh thute gen lo-in ka om theikei uh hi,” ci uh hi.

Thupiang hangin mi khempeuh in Pasian phat uh ahih manin ulian makaite zong tua mite' hangin sawltakte a gawt theih nading uh thu bangmah mu lo uh hi. Tua hangin lauphawnna a piakbeh khit uh ciangin ciahsak uh hi.
A hang pen hih damsakna lim a kibawlna mipa kum sawmli val a pha khat ahi hi.
Peter leh John a kikhah ciangin amau' kipawlpihte' kiangah pai uh a, siampi liante leh makaite' thugen teng zasak uh hi.
Tua thu a zak ciangun amaute lungsim kikhatin Pasian' kiangah kiko-in hih bangin thungen uh hi: “Vantung, leitung, tuipi leh tuate' sunga om khempeuh a piangsak Topa Lianbel aw,
na nasempa ka pa uh David' kam zangin Kha Siangtho tawh hih bangin thu na gen hi, “‘Gentile mite bang hangin lungso thangpai uh a, Pasian' minamte in bang hangin thu a hawmpi-in geel uh ahi hiam?
Leitung kumpite kithawi-in uliante kikaikhawm uh a, Topa leh Ama' Sathau Kinilhpa langpang uh hi.’
A hang pen a taktakin hih khua ah Herod leh Pontius Pilate, a nihun Gentile mite leh Israel minamte tawh kikopin na sathau nilhpa, na nasem siangtho Jesu langpangin
nangma' khut leh nangma' geelna tawh a piang dinga na khensatsa thute sem uh hi.
Tu-in Topa aw, na nasemte' tunga amau' hong lauphawnnate awlmawh inla
a damsak dingin leh na nasem siangtho Jesu' min tawh kihilna lim lamdangte a bawl dingin na khut na zankhiat laitak na thu ka gensuak ngam nadingun na nasemte tungah lungsim hanna hong guan in.”
Thunget khit ciangin a kikaihkhopna mun uh liing a, amaute zong Kha Siangtho tawh kidimin lungsim hanna tawh Pasian' thu gensuak uh hi.
Tu-in thu-um mite a vekun lungsim leh lungtup kikhat uh a, kuamah in ama' neihsa khatpeuh aituam neih lo-in na khempeuh neitaang uh hi.
Sawltakte in Jesu Topa' thawhkikna thu, vangliatna a dimtak tawh teci pang uh a, amaute khempeuh' tungah hehpihna lianpi tung hi.
Amaute' lakah mizawng khat zong om lo hi. A hang pen leitang ahihkeileh inn a nei peuhpeuh in zuakkhia-in sumkhotte uh hong tawi-in
sawltakte' khe-phung ah koih uh a, mi kim tungah kitangsapna zui-in kihawmkhia hi.
Tua ciangin Barnabas (a khiatna hanthot siampa) ci-a sawltakte in a lawh uh, Cyprus tualsuak Levi mi Joseph in
ama' neihsa leitang mun khat zuak a, a sumkhotte hong tawi-in sawltakte' khe-phung ah koih hi.
